name: Olive tree
about: Made by tools/battle-models/med/scenery.py. Metres; x east, y right, z up from the ground at the foot. Scenery: nothing moves but what the wind moves (`sway`, 0 to 1 point by point: how far the wind moves that point; the game bends by it). near: close; mid: about a quarter of near; far: the plain shape for the whole view. Paints: 0 olive_bark, 1 olive_leaf2, 2 olive_leaf Mended by Tools/olive_mend.py (24 November): the trunk flares at its foot and narrows into its limbs; the crown's clumps smaller and lumpy.
